description:
Modernized fork of the OpenDMK "jmx-optional" JMXMP connector (JSR-160 generic
    connector over TCP). Derived from the discontinued OpenDMK reference implementation
    (CDDL-1.0 / GPLv2 with Classpath Exception, dual license). Targets JDK 21+ with
    TLS client-certificate propagation, Subject.callAs dispatch, fail-closed access
    control, RFC 4616 SASL/PLAIN server, and hardened wire deserialization.
